answer: Because the raven stake is held until the ivory settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the delta audit lists each exposure. A farm running 186 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. An attester must stake 7% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
